title: The Dawn of New Hollywood: Fred Roos Casting & Production Archive
contents: An extensive archive of casting and production materials, spanning six decades of American filmmaking. 1960s-2023. A comprehensive working archive documenting the casting and production processes of Fred Roos, spanning more than six transformative decades of American filmmaking.
description:
A comprehensive working archive documenting the casting and production processes of Fred Roos, spanning more than six transformative decades of American filmmaking.
